title: Blank icons in plasmashell and System Settings when icon theme in kdeglobals does not exist
line: When kdeglobals names an icon theme that isn't installed, the panel, tray and System Settings now show Breeze icons instead of blank ones.
explanation: The KDE platform theme created the global KIconLoader inside the KHintsSettings constructor (to read the toolbar icon size), before the Breeze fallback theme was set up. That loader then built its theme chain as the missing theme plus hicolor only, so every icon that only exists in Breeze came out blank in Qt Quick apps like plasmashell and System Settings. Marco's open MR stops creating the loader there (it reads ToolbarDefault from the theme's index.theme itself) and makes Breeze the platform theme's fallback icon theme, so the loader made later includes Breeze.

commits.message:
Marco Martin's MR !247 as-is (two commits):

KHintSettings Do not create a KIconLoader in KHintSettings ctor

We have a circular dependency here: KIconTheme needs KHintSettings
to correctly know which is the correct fallback theme, but it
was creating a KIconLoader in its own constructor, which in turn created
the KIconTheme for the app, before we had a khintsettings with the proper
fallback theme set.

reimplement the logic for getting the toolbar icon size from the theme

we can't get this default from KIconLoader as it needs KHintSettings
to already be there. so we have to read from index.theme by ourselves

media.caption: Pure master, Theme=doesnotexist after a session restart: Kickoff and the System Settings task are blank, most tray icons are missing, System Settings shows blank-page icons
Same steps with MR !247: Breeze icons everywhere

review.text: Marco Martin's MR !247 fixes the real init-order cycle: KHintsSettings built the global KIconLoader before the platform theme's Breeze fallback existed, so the theme chain lacked Breeze. Reading ToolbarDefault from index.theme duplicates a little KIconTheme logic but is commented and needed to break the cycle. Media show blank vs Breeze icons, and existing themes (breeze, breeze-dark, oxygen) were checked for regressions.
